doc_title: Quarrendon Capital Management LP Compliance Manual
notes: Seven substantive modifications sit beside six cosmetic edits, and four of them turn on a few words inside long paragraphs: the pre-clearance window, 30 to 60 days, a carve-out to the broker-loss exclusion, and 'may seek' becoming 'must obtain' pre-clearance. Outside Business Activities moves unchanged from 6.3 to 3.5, the number vacated by the deleted De Minimis Transaction Exemption, and the only edit in 1.3 is the cross-reference that follows it, so alignment by section number produces a spurious modification plus an add and delete pair. The removed exemption leaves no trace in any surviving section, so it is caught only by comparing the two section inventories.

changes.description: The boilerplate date for completing the next annual review rolls forward from February 28, 2026 to February 28, 2027; the at-least-annual review obligation is unchanged.
changes.prior_quote: The next annual review will be completed on or before February 28, 2026.
changes.current_quote: The next annual review will be completed on or before February 28, 2027.

changes.description: The cross-reference to the outside business activity disclosure requirement is renumbered from Section 6.3 to Section 3.5 to follow the relocated section; the certification itself is unchanged.
changes.prior_quote: has disclosed every outside business activity required by Section 6.3.
changes.current_quote: has disclosed every outside business activity required by Section 3.5.

changes.description: The insider trading prohibition, which extended only to the issuer's own debt, swaps and other derivatives, now also covers the securities of any other issuer (such as a competitor, supplier or acquirer) whose price the information could reasonably be expected to affect.
changes.prior_quote: The prohibition extends to an issuer's debt, swaps and other derivatives.
changes.current_quote: The prohibition extends to an issuer's debt, swaps and other derivatives, and to the securities of any other issuer, such as a competitor, supplier or acquirer, whose price the information could reasonably be expected to affect.

changes.description: Authority to remove an issuer from the Restricted List moves from any member of the Compliance Department to the CCO alone, who must make the removal determination.
changes.prior_quote: An issuer may be removed from the Restricted List by any member of the Compliance Department once Compliance has determined
changes.current_quote: An issuer may be removed from the Restricted List only by the CCO, once the CCO has determined

changes.description: The sentence on restrictions for wall-crossed Employees is reworded with identical meaning ('notifies them in writing' becomes 'gives them written notice'); the need-to-know duty and the restriction lasting until the CCO's written notice are unchanged.
changes.prior_quote: Employees brought over the wall must keep the information on a need-to-know basis and remain restricted until the CCO notifies them in writing that the restriction has ended.
changes.current_quote: Employees brought over the wall must keep the information on a need-to-know basis and remain restricted until the CCO gives them written notice that the restriction has ended.

changes.description: New expert network policy: expert network firms must be CCO-approved, each consultation must be pre-cleared one business day ahead, current insiders, recent (under six months) departees and government employees may not be consulted, calls open with a compliance script and are chaperoned on a sample basis.
changes.current_quote: Each expert network firm must be approved by the CCO and must agree in writing to screen its experts against the Adviser's restrictions.

changes.description: The pre-clearance approval window is shortened from the close of regular trading on the business day following approval to the close of regular trading on the day of approval.
changes.prior_quote: Pre-clearance approval is valid until the close of regular trading on the business day following the day on which it is granted
changes.current_quote: Pre-clearance approval is valid until the close of regular trading on the day on which it is granted

changes.description: The minimum holding period for Reportable Securities acquired in a Covered Account is lengthened from 30 to 60 calendar days.
changes.prior_quote: must be held for at least 30 calendar days from the trade date
changes.current_quote: must be held for at least 60 calendar days from the trade date

changes.description: The exemption from pre-clearance and the minimum holding period for common stock of issuers with a market capitalization above $10 billion, up to $25,000 per issuer in any rolling 30 calendar days, is deleted.
changes.prior_quote: a purchase or sale of the common stock of an issuer with a market capitalization above $10 billion requires no pre-clearance and is not subject to the minimum holding period

changes.description: The Outside Business Activities section moves, with identical text, from the end of Section 6 (6.3) to the end of the code of ethics in Section 3 (3.5).
changes.prior_quote: If an Employee is approved to serve as a director of a public company, Compliance will place that issuer on the Restricted List under Section 2.2 for the duration of the service.
changes.current_quote: If an Employee is approved to serve as a director of a public company, Compliance will place that issuer on the Restricted List under Section 2.2 for the duration of the service.

changes.description: A carve-out is added to the exclusion for losses caused by an executing broker or counterparty: the exclusion no longer applies where the broker or counterparty acted on inaccurate or incomplete instructions from the Adviser, so the Adviser now reimburses those losses.
changes.prior_quote: other than a loss caused by an executing broker or counterparty, which the Adviser will pursue against that party on the Fund's behalf.
changes.current_quote: other than a loss caused by an executing broker or counterparty that was not acting on inaccurate or incomplete instructions from the Adviser

changes.description: A typo is corrected from 'commision' to 'commission'; the bar on any commission or other remuneration to the Adviser or an affiliate on a cross trade is unchanged.
changes.prior_quote: and no commision or other remuneration may be paid to the Adviser or any affiliate
changes.current_quote: and no commission or other remuneration may be paid to the Adviser or any affiliate

changes.description: New short sale policy requiring Regulation SHO locates recorded in the order management system and barring Fund purchases in firm commitment offerings after short sales in the Rule 105 restricted period absent written CCO confirmation of an exception.
changes.current_quote: No Fund may purchase equity securities from an underwriter or other distribution participant in a firm commitment offering for cash if the Fund sold the same security short during the restricted period under Rule 105 of Regulation M

changes.description: The daily price reconciliation sentence is reworded with identical meaning; the 2 percent single-position investigation threshold is unchanged.
changes.prior_quote: The Operations Department reconciles the Administrator's prices to the Adviser's records daily and investigates any difference above 2 percent for a single position.
changes.current_quote: Each day, the Operations Department reconciles the Administrator's prices to the Adviser's records and investigates any single-position difference above 2 percent.

changes.description: Approval of valuation overrides moves from the Chief Financial Officer alone to the Valuation Committee, acting by a majority of its voting members that must include the CCO, and no override may be applied until the Committee approves it in writing.
changes.prior_quote: to the Chief Financial Officer, who may approve or reject it. No override may be applied to the net asset value of any Fund until the Chief Financial Officer has approved it in writing.
changes.current_quote: to the Valuation Committee, which may approve or reject it by the vote of a majority of its voting members, including the CCO. No override may be applied to the net asset value of any Fund until the Valuation Committee has approved it in writing.

changes.description: Pre-clearance of state and local political contributions by Covered Associates changes from optional ('may seek pre-clearance') to mandatory ('must obtain pre-clearance').
changes.prior_quote: a Covered Associate may seek pre-clearance from the CCO through the compliance system.
changes.current_quote: a Covered Associate must obtain pre-clearance from the CCO through the compliance system.

changes.description: The defined term for the third-party archiving service is renamed consistently from 'Archiving Vendor' to 'Archive Provider'; the archiving and review obligations are unchanged.
